$comment: Central harness config. All project-specific values live here — scripts read from this file, never hardcode. Copy and adapt for your project. No secrets here: API keys go in your environment / .env (never committed).

agent.$comment: Code-agent backend. {model} and {promptFile} are substituted at runtime. The prompt is also piped on stdin. To use a different backend (e.g. Claude Code) change 'command' and provide a matching stream adapter under loop/lib/adapters.

models.$comment: Model ids passed to the backend. Empty string = let the backend use its configured default.

paths.$comment: Repo-relative locations. The harness dir itself is loop/ (where these scripts live).

$productPaths_comment: Directories that count as 'product code'. Used for no-progress detection, scope-creep checks, and verify-skip. Add your source roots, e.g. ["src", "app", "server"].

net.$comment: Connectivity watchdog. Set probeHost to your model API host to enable SSE-stall + offline detection. Empty probeHost disables the net-watchdog entirely.

features.$comment: Optional subsystems. Disabled by default so the loop runs with zero external deps. Enable per your setup. 'memory' requires the pgvector stack (memory/pgvector). 'vision' requires a visual test runner + a vision-capable model.
